overview.description: The Fidelity Intermediate Municipal Income ETF (FIMU) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in investment grade fixed income. The fund is actively managed to invest in a diversified portfolio that holds investment grade tax-exempt municipal bonds, with dollar-weighted average maturity between three and ten years. FIMU was launched on Apr 15, 1977 and is issued by Fidelity.
